name: godot-connector
description: Connect MiniMax Code to the Godot editor via a local TCP bridge. Exposes 28 editor-driving MCP tools (open/run/lint/export/inspect scenes and resources) and a vendored Godot 4.7 docs skill. Source: fromlan/x-agent.
author: Fromlan
exampleQueries: Use godot_editor_info to show the currently running Godot editor state.
Open res://scenes/main.tscn and run it with godot_run_scene, then report any play errors.
Lint the scripts under res://scripts with godot_lint_scripts and summarize the failures.
Export the project using the 'Linux/X11' preset via godot_export_project.
